useCollectorApi.title: Reporting mode
useCollectorApi.description: Switches where this device's location is reported. ON (true) = HaloFort collector mode: goes through the device-feedback/JWT auth exchange and is sent to the HaloFort collector as a location_v1 event, tagged with tenant/device IDs - this is the production path. OFF (false) = Portal mode: posted directly to this connector's own backend at {baseUrl}/api/chromeos/location with no auth, so the location shows up in this project's own DeviceDashboard instead. Both modes use the same base URL below - only the path and whether auth is required differ.

baseUrl.title: Backend base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL used for both reporting modes (e.g. https://portal.qa.halofort.com). Overrides the build-time default baked in at package time - leave unset to use that default. The exact path appended depends on Reporting mode above.

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: HaloFort tenant ID to report as a fallback when the feedback/login API's JWT doesn't itself carry a tenant claim. Only used in Collector reporting mode. Overrides the build-time default from flavours.json.
